summary: Not at the flips. On BTC, ETH and SOL, entries when SuperTrend(10, 3) flipped up or down did no better than random candles on 1h, 4h or daily. The result that holds up is the 4h down trend state: 20 candles later, price had fallen 0.45% more than after random candles, and this held without its strongest stretch.

verdicts.text: No better than random entries on 1h, 4h or daily. This holds with a multiplier of 2, 3 or 4.

verdicts.use: Staying long while in an up trend
verdicts.text: Beat random entries by 0.44% on 4h, but only because of the run between Dec 25, 2020 and Mar 12, 2021. It showed nothing on 1h or daily.

verdicts.use: Staying short while in a down trend
verdicts.text: On 4h, price fell 0.45% more than after random candles, and the result held at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. It showed nothing on 1h or daily.

notes: On 1h, SuperTrend(10, 3) flipping up gave 1,851 entries in 1,790 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.13% ahead of random entries, which is inside the luck band. A multiplier of 2 flips about 1.7 times as often, and a multiplier of 4 about two thirds as often. Neither one beat random on any timeframe.

Shorting while SuperTrend(10, 3) was in a down trend on 4h gave 19,746 entries in 330 moves. Twenty candles later, price had fallen 0.45% more than after random candles, above the band's top of 0.31%. The result holds without its strongest stretch, between Apr 6 and Jun 15, 2022, and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. SOL carries most of it at 0.84%. BTC's 0.34% is fragile, and ETH's 0.18% is inside the band.

The 4h short result is strongest while the pair closed above its 200-day SMA, at 0.51%. That holds without its strongest stretch, between Jan 27 and Feb 17, 2025, and at every horizon. Below the SMA the gap is 0.25% and fragile. It rests on the stretch between Apr 6 and Jun 15, 2022, and without that stretch it is chance.

The long side on 4h looks like a mirror image, but it is not. SuperTrend(10, 3) in an up trend beat random entries by 0.44%. Without its 412 entries between Dec 25, 2020 and Mar 12, 2021, the gap is chance. Both regimes are fragile too: 0.40% above the 200-day SMA, and 0.32% below it, which leans on Jan 2–30, 2023.

On 1h, the trend state on either side was 0.03% from random, inside the band. On daily, the up trend state was 3.19% ahead, still inside its wide band. Above the 200-day SMA it rose to 2.77%, but only because of the stretch between Jul 31 and Nov 17, 2021, and below the SMA it showed 0.19%, which is nothing. A single entry can also fake a result: SOL's 1h flip up looked 0.33% better than random, but only because of one signal on Sep 9, 2020.

As a start condition, the flip itself adds nothing on these pairs, so on a long DCA bot the DCA orders and take profit do the work. The 4h down trend state is the one shape worth adding as a filter beside other conditions on a short bot, because price tended to keep falling after it. The 4h up trend state on a long bot leaned on one rally, and on 1h neither state did anything, so leave it out there.
